title.zh: 特朗普的对华关税威胁引发了加密史上最大规模爆仓
title.en: Trump's China tariff threat triggered crypto's largest liquidation ever

current_state.zh:
据 Startup Fortune 报道，美国总统特朗普对中国的关税威胁引发了加密市场有记录以来规模最大的爆仓事件，各交易所的杠杆头寸被强制平仓。报道将此次连环爆仓归因于这一宏观冲击，而非加密行业自身的任何事件。

该事件被描述为加密史上规模最大的爆仓，而触发因素来自行业之外——华盛顿的政策威胁，而非加密领域自身的故障。

爆仓是指在保证金耗尽后杠杆头寸被强制平仓，这在加密市场的高波动环境中时有发生。报道称此次平仓波及多家交易所的杠杆头寸。
current_state.en: A tariff threat from Trump against China triggered the largest liquidation event ever recorded in crypto markets, as leveraged positions were wiped out across exchanges.

updates.detailed_summary_zh: A tariff threat from Trump against China triggered the largest liquidation event ever recorded in crypto markets, as leveraged positions were wiped out across exchanges.
updates.detailed_summary_en: A tariff threat from Trump against China triggered the largest liquidation event ever recorded in crypto markets, as leveraged positions were wiped out across exchanges.
updates.background_zh: 杠杆让交易者能用较少的本金控制远大于本金的仓位，因此价格出现相对较小的不利波动，就可能耗尽一笔交易的抵押资金并触发强制平仓。这类连环爆仓通常集中在提供永续合约、交割合约和期权的衍生品交易所，也是未平仓合约和杠杆最集中的地方。
updates.background_en: Leverage allows a trader to control a position much larger than the capital posted, so a comparatively small adverse price move can consume the collateral behind a trade and force an exit. These cascades typically concentrate on derivatives venues that list perpetual futures, dated futures and options, where open interest and leverage build up.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导渠道在于衍生品流动性：杠杆头寸被强制平仓会消耗保证金并使永续合约与期货交易所的订单簿变薄，从而把来自加密市场之外的宏观政治冲击传导进加密资产价格。报道所述的规模意味着这是一次跨交易所的广泛去杠杆，而非局限于单一资产或单一平台的事件。
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission channel runs through derivatives liquidity: forced closures of leveraged positions consume margin and thin order books on perpetual and futures venues, transmitting a macro-political shock from outside crypto into crypto pricing. The scale described implies broad, cross-venue deleveraging rather than an event confined to one asset or platform.
